items.item_text: HR Policy & Standard Operating Procedures:

Responsible for the HR policy and standard operating procedure (SOP) library; drafts, updates, and maintains SOPs, desk manuals, process maps, forms, and guides in partnership with HR subject matter experts.
Ensures HR procedures are current and consistent with UC systemwide policy, local procedures, and collective bargaining agreements.
Monitors UC systemwide policy changes and employment law changes; notifies affected HR units and coordinates related updates to procedures and communications.
Coordinates the local review, approval, and communication of HR policies and procedures; maintains a review schedule, version control, and a central repository.
Researches and responds to policy and procedural questions, escalating complex issues as appropriate.
Administrative, Project & Confidential Support to the CHRO
Provides high-level administrative and project support to the CHRO and HR leadership team, including preparing correspondence, reports, presentations, briefing materials, and data summaries.
Supports the CHRO by confidentially gathering, organizing, and summarizing information and data requested for collective bargaining preparation or strategic planning.
Leads assigned HR projects from planning through completion, including developing work plans, timelines, and status updates, and coordinating with staff across HR units.
Coordinates HR leadership meetings, planning sessions, and retreats, including agendas, materials, notes, action items, and follow-up tracking.
Maintains the annual HR calendar and tracks the status of HR-wide projects and priorities for HR leadership.
Maintains strict confidentiality of personnel, labor relations, and bargaining information.
HR Operations, Reporting & Continuous Improvement
Gathers, analyzes, and reports HR data, and prepares recurring and ad hoc reports for HR leadership using standard tools and reporting systems.
Supports day-to-day HR operations across units, such as shared forms, workflows, intake processes, and HR systems and tools.
Identifies opportunities to improve HR processes and recommends practical changes to HR leadership.
Coordinates updates to HR website content and shared resources.
Participates in HR and cross-campus committees and working groups as assigned.
Maintains current knowledge of HR practices across all functional areas and how they operate together.
Personnel Files, Records Management & Retention

Is responsible for the maintenance of employee personnel files and associated processes, including access and responses to records requests, in accordance with UC policy, collective bargaining agreements, and applicable privacy laws.
Administers HR records management and retention schedules, including periodic audits and timely archiving and disposition of records.
Trains HR staff on personnel file and records management practices.
Support to HR Units & Programs
Assists HR units and provides backup support for their work as needed, including during peak cycles, vacancies, or high-volume periods.

Assists with the coordination of HR programs and initiatives, such as employee engagement programs, wellness programs, recognition and awards programs, development programs, lactation accommodation, and other employee programs and services.
Supports program logistics as needed, such as communications, event planning, materials, and campus partner coordination.
Assists in compiling materials for information requests and other projects as directed by HR unit leads.
Assists the labor relations unit during peak workloads of collective bargaining and contract implementation.
